# Dan Murphy

Dan Murphy is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2003.

Dan Murphy has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2003 Grouville Connétable By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy#e23)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville with 62.5% of the vote.
- [**2004 Grouville Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy#e30)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville unopposed.
- [**2007 Grouville Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy#e8)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville with 61.9% of the vote.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville unopposed.
- [**2011 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy#e14)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville unopposed.

## Election History

### 2003 Grouville Connétable By-Election

By-election following the resignation of Frank Amy due to ill-health (1 seat), 17th September 2003.

**Dan Murphy was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2003**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Dan Murphy** |  | 851 | 62.5% |
| 2 | [Bruce Willing](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bruce-willing) |  | 505 | 37.1% |
| 3 | ~~[John Lamy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-lamy)~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

1,361 votes (inc. 5 spoilt papers)

2,892 registered voters

= 47.1% turnout

### 2007 Grouville Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) (1 seat), 25th July 2007.

**Dan Murphy was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2007**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Dan Murphy** |  | 1,040 | 61.9% |
| 2 | [John Le Maistre](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre) |  | 641 | 38.1% |

1,681 votes

3,160 registered voters

= 53.2% turnout
